messages:
Marta: FYI: after last night's RBAC roll, several sync jobs for nova-enterprises are failing with 401/403. IdP reports show OIDC aud validation failures referencing client_id=nova-portal-retired. Any recent rotations?
Diego: I rotated the client (new client_id + secret) to retire the old one. I updated the main tenant, but looks like a batch SCIM connector for nova was missed.
Claire: KMS telemetry: brief spike of InvalidCiphertextException on alias/idp-primary around 04:02 UTC during key promotion. Could be tokens failing to decrypt while SCIM retried.
Marta: SCIM probe extracts show retries that created duplicate service accounts when extId lookups failed. Example log: `[2026-06-11T04:03:15Z] scim-sync nova: 401 aud mismatch (client=nova-portal-retired)` then later `[2026-06-11T04:03:18Z] scim-sync nova: 201 Created -> user user-456-dup`
Diego: Short-term: add retired client to gateway aud allowlist while we coordinate updates. @audit-bot can you record the temporary exception and who approved?
audit-bot: Audit event: gateway.aud.allowlist add `nova-portal-retired` approved_by=Diego timestamp=1867004460
kms-bot: Scheduled re-encrypt sweep for items with decrypt failures. INF-KMS-77 alert created for InvalidCiphertextException >= 4 in 5m.
Claire: During review I found a dev-runner job that uploaded a debug bundle to s3://dev-temp/nova/debug_trace.log which includes `oauth_client_secret` in plaintext. That job had broad PutObject perms.
Marta: Action plan: 1) rotate client secret and update IdP app + SCIM connectors, 2) purge the S3 object including previous versions and run S3 object-lock purge where applicable, 3) revoke refresh tokens so leaked secret is unusable, 4) restrict job IAM perms and audit similar buckets for secrets.
Diego: Rotating now. I'll also push a targeted SCIM connector update for nova and schedule a maintenance window to sync the rest.
Claire: KMS re-encrypt sweep finished; decrypt failures dropped to baseline and 0 items remain queued. Re-encrypt cleared ~31 items.
Marta: We also need to reconcile duplicates: export placed at s3://redwood-incident/nova/dupes-1867004444.csv. Reconcile logic: dedupe by extId, merge last_active, preserve admin role if any.
Diego: Pushed SCIM idempotency patch: upsert on extId to avoid fallback creates. PR link: internal repo (private).
Marta: Postmortem items: 1) coordination checklist for OAuth rotations (IdP, SCIM connectors, gateway) 2) CI rule to block debug artifacts containing secrets 3) tighten IAM on debug runners 4) KMS alert INF-KMS-77 + dashboard 5) reconcile job to detect and merge duplicates by extId+last_active 6) limit gateway allowlist grace to max 24h.
Claire: I'll file INF-888 for the CI check and INF-889 for the S3 audit sweep. Keeping the allowlist entry for 12h while we confirm no downstream errors.
Diego: :thumbsup: I'll post a customer note and follow up when the allowlist is removed.
